shared.query_objective: normalized projected query dot product against all entity and predicate vectors

compgcn.relation_updates: learned linear update at each layer

training.negative_filter: training-split positives only; unobserved triples are not known false
training.message_passing: training edges only for transductive; all incident held-out entity edges removed for unseen-entity partition

comparison.primary: +0.10 absolute Recall@10 over the stronger matched text method (BM25 or EmbeddingGemma)
comparison.structural: positive paired Recall@10 change over native QV2 source-witnessed retrieval, which receives the same raw question text; structured adjacency is reported as an oracle ceiling, not a pass threshold
comparison.uncertainty: paired bootstrap 95% interval on test query groups; lower bound must exceed zero
comparison.two_hop_path_reporting: measure endpoint rank only when the retrieved candidate can be attached to the exact source-quads path; query-structure traversal is an oracle path source, not a learned path score
comparison.regressions: report per-language, direction, depth, exact-IRI, scope, no-match and source-witness outcomes; no scope/direction/identifier safety regression
comparison.candidate_generation: record full-pool recall before any shared-pool reranking; score all N entities and 84 predicates for query ranking

judgments: Agent-authored, source-checked development references only; no expert gold or independent semantic claim.
limitations: EmbeddingGemma Wikidata feature vectors have not been generated.
The test split has 28 relevant questions, including only four two-hop queries.
The deterministic adjacency result uses structured query hints and is an oracle, not a natural-language baseline.
No unseen-entity results exist until the separately frozen node-disjoint run completes.

authorization.feature_inference: requires approval bound to model/dataset/question hashes; local model assets only
authorization.full_training: requires approval bound to this run-manifest hash, feature-manifest hash, and read-only preflight receipt
